title: Vercel Drives adds CLI commands and standalone SDKs
summary_en: You can now create, list, fork, and delete Vercel Drives with the new vercel drives commands or standalone SDKs for TypeScript ( @vercel/drives ) and Python ( vercel-drives ). Drives also have a REST API at /v1/drives and Drive-specific permissions, so managing them no longer requires Sandbox APIs or permissions. With the latest Vercel CLI, link your project with vercel link if needed, then run: Install the TypeScript SDK with npm install @vercel/drives , or the Python SDK with pip install vercel-drives , then run: Drives still mount into Vercel Sandboxes as before, and existing Sandbox CLI…
